description: We are Team AETHERIS, developing an innovative Earth Intelligence platform using NASA data to detect, analyze, and explain environmental changes. Our project combines scientific research, statistical analysis, interactive visualizations, and geospatial technology. We aim to make complex Earth science data accessible, understandable, and reproducible. We welcome passionate developers, data scientists, Earth science enthusiasts, and creative problem-solvers.
summary:
AETHERIS is an interactive Earth intelligence platform that helps people investigate environmental changes using NASA POWER climate data. It transforms historical temperature and precipitation records into clear, reproducible scientific evidence.

Users can explore geographic locations, compare multiple cities, analyze annual and seasonal trends, inspect possible change points, and examine the strength and limitations of each finding. Its Research Campaign Studio compares temperature and rainfall across up to six locations, while the Scientific Quality Passport highlights missing data, trend stability, and statistical uncertainty.

AETHERIS also includes an interactive Earth globe, evidence visualizations, downloadable scientific reports, and reproducibility packages containing data, methodology, and verification scripts.

Our goal is to make Earth science more accessible to students, educators, researchers, and communities, empowering them to understand environmental change through transparent analysis rather than unsupported claims.
details:
AETHERIS — Discover Earth's Hidden Changes

The Challenge

Our planet is constantly changing, but understanding these changes requires more than simply looking at graphs. Climate data can be difficult to interpret, particularly when observations are incomplete, trends are uncertain, or multiple environmental variables interact.

AETHERIS was developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge "Be An Earth System Trend Detective!" to make scientific investigation of Earth's environmental changes more accessible, transparent, and reproducible.

Our Solution

AETHERIS is an interactive Earth Intelligence platform that transforms NASA historical meteorological data into evidence-based investigations.

Using NASA POWER data, the platform enables users to examine temperature and precipitation changes across geographic locations and historical periods.

Our approach follows five principles:

Explore → Analyze → Compare → Verify → Communicate

How AETHERIS Works

1. Interactive Earth Exploration

Users explore geographic locations through interactive maps and a 3D Earth visualization. They can select coordinates, climate variables, and historical periods.

2. Scientific Trend Detection

AETHERIS retrieves monthly NASA POWER observations and processes them into annual and seasonal indicators. The scientific engine calculates trends, anomalies, uncertainty estimates, and robust statistical comparisons.

3. Research Campaign Studio

Users can investigate temperature and precipitation across two to six geographic locations within one research campaign, comparing their historical trends and individual annual observations.

4. Earth Time Machine

An interactive timeline helps users explore how temperature or precipitation anomalies evolve over time across nine sampled geographic points.

5. Scientific Quality Passport

The platform examines missing observations, annual completeness, agreement between statistical methods, and sensitivity to individual years.

6. Evidence and Reproducibility

Each investigation provides source metadata, methodological explanations, and data-integrity fingerprints. Users can export scientific results in JSON, CSV, and PDF formats, as well as reproducibility packages for independent verification.

7. Scientific Storytelling

Evidence Command Center and Mission Theater help communicate findings through interactive visualizations and exportable presentations.

Technologies Used

AETHERIS was developed using:

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, Uvicorn, HTTPX.
  • Scientific computing: NumPy, SciPy, Statsmodels.
  • Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript.
  • 3D visualization: Three.js and WebGL.
  • Geographic visualization: Natural Earth geographic data.
  • Data source: NASA POWER Monthly Point API.
  • Reporting: ReportLab, CSV, JSON, and HTML.
  • Development and deployment: GitHub, Git, and Vercel.

The application is designed to run through a web browser without requiring specialized hardware or a dedicated GPU.

What Makes AETHERIS Different?

AETHERIS focuses on the credibility of environmental investigations, not only on visual presentation.

It combines geographic exploration, multi-variable analysis, statistical diagnostics, and reproducible evidence within one application.

Instead of presenting conclusions without context, AETHERIS helps users understand what changed, how strongly the data supports the observed trend, and which limitations must be considered.

Intended Impact

AETHERIS is designed for students, educators, researchers, environmental enthusiasts, and communities seeking to understand historical environmental changes.

By making NASA data easier to explore and interpret, the platform aims to strengthen scientific literacy, support environmental awareness, and encourage evidence-based discussions.

Scientific Responsibility

AETHERIS uses model-derived, gridded meteorological observations rather than direct measurements from individual weather stations.

Its statistical analyses are exploratory. Correlation does not establish causation, and historical patterns do not automatically provide reliable future predictions.

AETHERIS is an independent educational and scientific research project, not an official NASA product.

Our vision: One Planet. Many Signals. One Clearer Understanding.
